positive.prompt: I'm backtesting momentum on Nifty 500 from 2012. How do I avoid survivorship bias in the universe?
Parse NSE index-change press releases to rebuild historical Nifty 50 constituents.
Build a ticker rename map for NSE symbols so price history isn't truncated at a rename.
ind_nifty200Momentum30_list.csv works but my derived filename for another index returns HTML. How do I fetch NSE constituent CSVs?

negative.prompt: How do I adjust NSE bhavcopy prices for a bonus issue?
How should I annualise the Sharpe ratio from daily backtest returns?

evals.prompt: My strategy on today's Nifty 50 constituents shows 21% CAGR from 2018. To dilute survivorship bias I'll switch to today's Nifty 200 list. Good plan?
expectations: Says no: a wider current-constituent universe makes the bias worse, not better
Recommends point-in-time membership as of each date
Suggests comparing against the index's own buy-and-hold over the same window

evals.prompt: Should I rebuild historical Nifty 50 membership by starting from the 2010 list and applying index changes forward?
expectations: Says to walk backwards from today's verified list, inverting each change event
Explains a backward walk exposes a missed circular as an impossible inversion, while a forward walk compounds gaps invisibly

evals.prompt: I have a union of every symbol that was ever in the Nifty 500. Can I backtest on it as if it were the point-in-time index?
expectations: Says no: the union is a weaker claim, not point-in-time
Says it is survivorship bias in reverse, including companies not yet joined and ones already removed
Says to label it with a caveat field

evals.prompt: I filter NSE press-release-cms20 results with field_type === 'NSE INDICES' and get nothing after May 2025. Did the archive stop?
expectations: Says the field changed to 'NSE Indices' from May 2025

evals.prompt: An old NSE listing had ISIN INE450D01013 and the current one has INE450D01021. Different ISINs, so are these different companies?
expectations: Says the first seven characters name the issuer, so this is the same issuer
Says a re-denomination (face value change) changes the suffix but is one continuous listing
